import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 505;
    static int mod;
    static long[][] C = new long[N][N];
    static int[] g = new int[N];
    static int[] f = new int[N];
    static int[][] dp1 = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dp2 = new int[N][N];

    static class FastMod {
        long b, m;
        public void init(long b) {
            this.b = b;
            long LLL = (1L << 64);
            this.m = (LLL / b);
        }
        public long operator(long a) {
            long r = a - (long)((m * a) >> 64) * b;
            return r >= b ? r - b : r;
        }
    }

    static FastMod M = new FastMod();

    static long s(int x) {
        return (long) x * (x + 1) / 2;
    }

    static void add(int[] a, int b) {
        a[0] += b;
        if (a[0] >= mod) a[0] -= mod;
    }

    static void add(int[] a, long b) {
        a[0] += b;
        if (a[0] >= mod) a[0] -= mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        M.init(mod);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
                if (C[i][j] >= mod) C[i][j] -= mod;
            }
        }

        g[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                int tmp = (int) C[i - 1][j - 1];
                long coef = M.operator(M.operator(1L * g[j - 1] * g[i - j]) * tmp);
                add(f, (int) M.operator(M.operator(1L * f[j - 1] * g[i - j]) + 1L * g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) * (i + 1) * tmp);
                add(f, (int) M.operator((s(j - 1) + s(i - j)) * coef));
                add(g, (int) M.operator(coef * (i + 1)));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(dp1[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(dp2[i], 0);
        }
        dp2[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                add(dp1[i + 1], dp1[i][j]);
                add(dp2[i + 1], dp2[i][j]);
                for (int k = 1; i + k <= n && j + k <= m; ++k) {
                    int tmp = (int) C[j + k][j];
                    add(dp1[i + k + 1][j + k], (int) M.operator(M.operator(1L * tmp * dp1[i][j]) * g[k]));
                    add(dp1[i + k + 1][j + k], (int) M.operator(M.operator(1L * tmp * dp2[i][j]) * f[k]));
                    add(dp2[i + k + 1][j + k], (int) M.operator(M.operator(1L * tmp * dp2[i][j]) * g[k]));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp1[n + 1][m]);
    }
}
